message.text: Form Elements + Pricing views are built and match the Figma pngs closely (screenshots proved it in a standalone harness) — but `ai2/card.js` never reads the `{"place":"view.js"}` line, so no section card will actually show its view yet. Someone with write access to ai2/card.js needs to add a step in Card.draw() that imports each placed .js and appends it (the same job core/Page/Log.js's draw_placed already does), or none of the 7 cards will show anything.

Sections 5 (2-Col: Sidebar + Content) and 6 (UI Controls) are built and committed — view.js + view.css + figma.png in each card folder, matched against their png closely (screenshots checked in a standalone harness). Heads up: ai2/card.js's own content()/draw() never calls the placed-file machinery in core/Page/Log.js, so a plain {"place":"view.js"} line on a card's page.jsonl currently draws nothing on its AI2 card page — that wiring still needs adding (in card.js, outside my fence) before step 6 can show these live.

Fixed and committed (e4973434): both cards now sit in a container-query size container, font-size set from the container's own width (16px at Figma's 856px), every padding/gap/radius/font-size below it in em — no more clipping or stacked tiles at the real ~400px column. Card 6 now has three separately-titled "Progress & Sliders" groups (plain, darken-2, lighten-2), accent-filled vs light-bordered chips, and square accent counts. Reshot with figma-probe.mjs against the live board at the real card width — both match their Figma section closely now. Remaining difference: accent colour is the site's --prim (orange-red) vs Figma's blue, per the token-mapping instruction — everything else (proportions, text, structure) matches.

Section 6, last round done and committed (b67e00ee): track and off-toggle are now light grey (var(--darken-1)), the two nested "Progress & Sliders" titles are sentence-case semibold ~1.4em, and the second box is near-white (var(--surface)). Reshot against the live board — matches your notes. Both sections 5 and 6 are done from my end.

Done and committed (a6c31f33): outer "Progress & Sliders" is now a small uppercase label like the other sections, only the two nested boxes keep the big title, and group spacing is 1.5x — reshot and matches. Sections 5 and 6 are finished.
